caption: The drawing depicts two glass bottles. The main object fills the center of the composition and is a round, flattened bottle with a short, narrow neck and a small mouth. Its color is a consistent amber or light brown with highlights and shadows depicted to give a three-dimensional effect, and vertical grooves run from the neck down to the base. In the upper right corner, a smaller inset shows the same bottle shape but in a more elongated, upright form. It features the same grooves and amber coloration. The background is a plain, light beige color. There is a small ruler-like scale near the bottom left corner, and the artist's signature “John Tsarouhis” appears beneath the main bottle to the right.
title: Flask
